title: Laparoscopically guided biopsy of non-macroscopically altered cecocolic lymph nodes in dog cadavers using laparoscopic forceps or core needles

sections.text:

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Laparoscopically guided biopsy of non-macroscopically altered cecocolic lymph nodes in dog cadavers using laparoscopic forceps or core needles》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Three techniques were performed in randomized order across 17 fresh cadavers, collecting three specimens per technique (153 total specimens, yielding 51 technique-level histological assessments).

evidence.text: Three techniques were performed in randomized order across 17 fresh cadavers, collecting three specimens per technique (153 total specimens, yielding 51 technique-level histological assessments).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Laparoscopically guided biopsy of non-macroscopically altered cecocolic lymph nodes in dog cadavers using laparoscopic forceps or core needles》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Both pancreatic forceps and cup forceps with teeth yielded higher composite adequacy scores than core needle biopsy (adjusted p = 0.019 and 0.006, respectively), whereas the two forceps did not differ (p = 0.504).

evidence.text: Both pancreatic forceps and cup forceps with teeth yielded higher composite adequacy scores than core needle biopsy (adjusted p = 0.019 and 0.006, respectively), whereas the two forceps did not differ (p = 0.504).
